title: Bivvy cancelled my dog’s insurance at…
text: Bivvy cancelled my dog’s insurance at his one year mark. He’s getting older and he’s a big boy, so he’s been having some issues with his back hips and legs. Upon speaking with Bivvy they informed me if I can wait another month for surgery until he hit his one year mark, they would begin coverage for orthopedic conditions. So I waited the month, now coming up on his one year mark I went to schedule the appointment and found that his insurance would be cancelled at the one year mark. They suggested I move his coverage to spot and upon calling spot I was informed I would have to wait six months before orthopedic conditions are covered and because his has already been realized, it is pre-existing and will not be covered. So now I’m completely heartbroken and completely out of luck. I paid for this insurance for a year for nothing and now I have no choice but to pay for the surgery entirely out of pocket even though I did everything in my power to have insurance for him. Do not use this company they will screw you over.

title: Stay away from this DISHONEST and SHADY company
text:
I submitted a claim for a condition which symptoms first appears in March of 2021. My Bivvy policy started in October of 2020. Bivvy is saying this is a preexisting condition. The injury occurred 4 months after our policy started! Unbelievable. Total scam.

UPDATE: I reached out to Bivvy regarding the denial and their false preexisting condition claim. They are now claiming the condition started in April of 2020 a full 11 months prior to when the initially claimed the condition first occurred. Regardless both claims are false. They seem to be throwing out dates to see what will stick and when I question their reasoning the change their story.  SERIOSULY, stay away from this dishonest and shady company.

title: Wonderful People, Great Experiences
text: For my sweet Gracie, the only claim I had to file was for treatment, euthanasia, and cremation in her last 36 hours of life. The deductible was taken out plus the copay. It was a great help during one of the worst experiences of my life. The responding email from Bivvy expressed condolences on my loss and was a sweet surprise and a comfort. My Sadie is 8 months, I’ve had her for 4.  She’s already had 2 claims, one for an after hours emergency. My vet has more than doubled their emergency fee! It matched my deductible, but the rest was covered, except for my copay.  It has been a very simple and quick process with my claims. I’ve looked at other pet insurance companies, and I simply can’t afford their premiums. As well, the negative reviews have been horrendous! And a lot require the deductible on every claim, and also raise premiums without notice! I’m a retired Paramedic with PTSD (Gracie was my service dog for nearly 10 of her 12 years), and hopefully Sadie will be as well. I am staying with Bivvy! I’ve been very happy with them so far! Especially during the loss of my Gracie.

title: Bivvy Cancelled Our Policy
text: I am saddened to write this review. Bivvy canceled our policy after we submitted several claims to them for our dog. She had a partial tear in her ACL. We took a holistic approach, purchased a brace, and took her to the vet for laser therapy and acupuncture. This saved Bivvy thousands of dollars they would have paid if we chose knee surgery for our dog. I was very delighted Bivvy covered the brace and treatments. But was very disappointed when they canceled Sadie's pet insurance. I recommend finding a more reliable pet insurance company with a long-term history of support for your fur babies. Sadie is now out of her brace and no longer needs treatments and her other knee has stayed strong and healthy.

After requesting a re-review, and providing all supporting documentation, Alisha with Bivvy reviewed the information and corrected their decision  to cover all related claims. 

These claims were not Hip Dysplasia claims but rather the diagnosis from the two veterinarians as possible cancer. 

At this time until further notice, we do recommend Bivvy Pet Insurance for their professionalism, quick response, dedication and attention to the clients needs.
